description: Each weekday at a set time, two bank reports from Xero. The balance report is one line per bank account: its balance at the close of the previous business day (Friday on a Monday), its balance today, and the movement between them. The transaction detail lists, account by account, each transaction at or above the amount set (A$50,000 by default), with everything smaller counted on one line so the totals still add up; AI explains in plain English what moved each balance. Both go to Reports as web pages, are filed in Knowledge as PDFs under Banking/Reports, and are emailed as attachments to the people picked. Read-only in Xero.

Taller than this and it crowds the rule beneath; wider and it reaches the title block. LOGO_H = 11.0 LOGO_W = 60.0 # The whole PDF is base64'd into the mail connector's request, and a logo straight out of a design tool can # be megabytes. It is drawn 11mm tall, so a few hundred pixels is every pixel it can show. LOGO_PX = (960, 240) LOGO_BYTES = 120_000 NAVY = (22, 37, 64) GOLD = (176, 141, 87) GREEN = (29, 115, 80) RED = (176, 44, 44) INK = (33, 37, 41) GREY = (110, 114, 120) LINE = (222, 220, 214) PAPER = (244, 242, 237) WHITE = (255, 255, 255) def safe(s): """Core PDF fonts are Latin-1 only.""" s = str(s or "") for a, b in (("–", "-"), ("—", "-"), ("‘", "'"), ("’", "'"), ("“", '"'), ("”", '"'), ("•", "-"), ("…", "..."), ("→", "->"), ("·", "-"), ("▲", "+"), ("▼", "-"), ("≈", "~"), (" ", " ")): s = s.replace(a, b) return s.encode("latin-1", "ignore").decode("latin-1") def esc(s): return (str(s or "").replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") .replace('"', """)) def d_fmt(iso): """dd-Mmm-yy, for the file name and the email subject.""" if not iso: return "" y, m, d = iso[:10].split("-") return d + "-" + MONTHS[int(m) - 1] + "-" + y[2:] def money(n): return "A$" + format(abs(float(n or 0)), ",.2f") def tone_rgb(direction): return GREEN if direction == "up" else (RED if direction == "down" else GREY) def tone_css(direction): return "#1d7350" if direction == "up" else ("#b02c2c" if direction == "down" else "#6e7278") def moved(account): return abs(float(account.get("difference") or 0)) >= 0.005 change = params.get("change") or {} problem = str(params.get("problem") or "") # The Xero organisation the figures were read from, straight from the connector. It is also the name at the top. org_name = str(params.get("org_name") or "").strip() source_line = "Xero organisation: " + org_name if org_name else "Xero organisation not identified" head = change.get("summary") or {} accounts = change.get("accounts") or [] # -- Who gets it --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Two ways of saying who, and the report goes to both at once: one person picked from the workspace, and any # addresses typed in for people outside it. Picking beats typing - nobody mistypes an address that then bounces # where no one sees it. to = [] lost = [] people = {} user_id = str(params.get("email_user") or "").strip() if user_id: try: for person in api.users.list() or []: people[str(person.get("id") or "")] = person except Exception as exc: lost.append("couldn't read the workspace users (" + str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")") wanted = [] if user_id: wanted.append(user_id) for who in wanted: found = people.get(who) or {} if found.get("email"): picked = str(found.get("email")).strip() if picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]: to.append(picked) elif who: lost.append("someone picked has no email address on their profile") for typed in str(params.get("email_to") or "").replace(";", ",").split(","): picked = typed.strip() if picked and picked.lower() not in [x.lower() for x in to]: to.append(picked) # Said once, however many people it happened to: the point is that the list is short, not who is missing. lost = sorted(set(lost)) lost_note = (" Some recipients were left off: " + "; ".join(lost) + ".") if lost else "" # The business's logo, where one has been put in Knowledge. A logo that will not load is said so in the # summary and the name is set instead - a missing picture is no reason to lose the report. logo_file = str(params.get("logo_file") or "").strip() logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_size = (0, 0) logo_note = "" if logo_file: try: with open(str(api.files.get(file=logo_file)), "rb") as fh: img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(fh.read())) img.load() img.thumbnail(LOGO_PX) buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/png", ".png" if buf.tell() > LOGO_BYTES and img.mode in ("RGB", "L"): buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="JPEG", quality=85, optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/jpeg", ".jpg" logo_raw = buf.getvalue() logo_size = img.size logo_path = api.files.scratch_path("logo" + ext) with open(logo_path, "wb") as fh: fh.write(logo_raw) logo_uri = "data:" + kind + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(logo_raw).decode("ascii") except Exception as exc: logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_note = " The logo was left off: " + logo_file + " wouldn't load (" + \ str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120] + ")." report_file = "" report_link = "" emailed_to = "" sent = "" filed = "" if problem or not accounts: summary = problem or "Nothing to report." else: today = date.today().isoformat() title_name = org_name or "Bank Balances" # A cursor walked down the page, taking a new one whenever the next row will not fit. page = [1] y_now = [0.0] def need(h): if y_now[0] + h <= BOTTOM: return page[0] += 1 y_now[0] = masthead(False) y_now[0] = masthead(True) # -- Total across the accounts ------------------------------------------------------------------------- total_dir = str(head.get("totalDirection") or "flat") pdf.set_fill_color(*PAPER) pdf.set_draw_color(*LINE) pdf.set_line_width(0.2) pdf.rect(L, y_now[0], CW, 20, style="DF") label(L + 6, y_now[0] + 7, "Total change across " + str(head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts)) + (" account" if (head.get("accountCount") or len(accounts)) == 1 else " accounts")) font(18, "B", color=tone_rgb(total_dir)) pdf.text(L + 6, y_now[0] + 16, safe(str(head.get("totalDifferenceText") or ""))) # The closing balances added up. On a page that is only balances, the one figure that isn't on any row # is the one the reader does in their head otherwise. held = sum(float(a.get("balance") or 0) for a in accounts) font(7.5, "", color=GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 8) pdf.cell(CW - 6, 4, safe("Held across all accounts"), align="R") font(12, "B", color=NAVY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] + 12) pdf.cell(CW - 6, 5, safe(money(held)), align="R") y_now[0] += 26 # -- One row per account ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- c_prev, c_bal, c_chg = 42.0, 42.0, 38.0 c_name = CW - c_prev - c_bal - c_chg label(L, y_now[0], "Account", size=6) label(L + c_name, y_now[0], "Previous close", size=6) label(L + c_name + c_prev, y_now[0], "Balance today", size=6) font(6, "B", color=GREY) pdf.set_char_spacing(0.6) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0] - 2.4) pdf.cell(CW, 3.6, safe("CHANGE"), align="R") pdf.set_char_spacing(0) y_now[0] += 2.2 rule(y_now[0], color=NAVY, width=0.4) y_now[0] += 4.2 for a in accounts: need(11) name = str(a.get("name") or "") direction = str(a.get("direction") or "flat") font(9, "B", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_name, 4.4, fit(name, c_name - 3, 9, "B")) font(9, "", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_prev, 4.4, fit(str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or ""), c_prev - 3, 9)) font(9, "B", color=INK) pdf.set_xy(L + c_name + c_prev, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(c_bal, 4.4, fit(str(a.get("balanceText") or ""), c_bal - 3, 9, "B")) font(9, "B", color=tone_rgb(direction) if moved(a) else GREY) pdf.set_xy(L, y_now[0]) pdf.cell(CW, 4.4, safe(str(a.get("differenceText") or "") if moved(a) else "no change"), align="R") # The day the previous balance is the close of, under the figure it belongs to. # ── Have AI explain, in plain English, what moved the balances ──
import json
import re

# The AI step's input cap is 32,000 characters including the prompt, so the brief is trimmed well inside it.
MAX_INPUT = 24000
SHORT_INPUT = 6000
# Transactions sent per account. A day with more than this is summarised by its largest movements.
MAX_TXNS = 40

WRITE_PROMPT = (
    "You are writing the daily bank balance note for the owner of an Australian small business. "
    "The figures come from their Xero bank accounts: each account's balance at the close of the previous "
    "business day, its balance today, and every transaction in between.\n"
    "Write for someone who is not an accountant. Short sentences, plain English, no jargon and no "
    "accounting lecture. Amounts are Australian dollars and are already formatted - quote them exactly as "
    "they appear, never reformat or recalculate them.\n"
    "You are given only the transactions at or above the size in 'listed_from'; the rest of each account's "
    "day is summarised as 'smaller_count' and 'smaller_total'. Write about the ones you were given, and "
    "refer to the others only as the smaller movements - never guess what they were.\n"
    "For each account that moved, say in two or three sentences what moved it: the handful of transactions "
    "that account for most of the change, who they were with, and whether money came in or went out. Name "
    "the real contacts. Do not list every transaction - the report already has the full table underneath.\n"
    "Then give up to four 'watch' points: anything a careful owner would want a second look at, such as a "
    "large or unusual payment, a duplicate-looking pair, bank fees, or an account that has gone negative. "
    "Leave the list empty when nothing stands out - do not invent concerns to fill it.\n"
    "Never state a fact that is not in the data."
)
WRITE_SHAPE = ('{"headline": str, "accounts": [{"name": str, "explanation": str}], "watch": [str]}')

SHORT_PROMPT = (
    "Write one plain-English sentence for the owner of an Australian small business saying how their bank "
    "balances moved since the previous business day. Use the amounts exactly as given. No jargon."
)
SHORT_SHAPE = '{"headline": str}'


def _brief_txn(t):
    return {
        "account_code": str(t.get("accountCode") or ""),
        "coded_to": str(t.get("accountName") or ""),
        "contact": str(t.get("contact") or ""),
        "detail": str(t.get("detail") or ""),
        "amount": str(t.get("amountDisplay") or ""),
        "direction": "out" if float(t.get("amount") or 0) < 0 else "in",
    }


def _by_size(t):
    return -abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0))


change = params.get("change") or {}
problem = str(params.get("problem") or "")
notes = {"headline": "", "accounts": [], "watch": [], "note": ""}

# The report lists transactions of this size and over, so the explanation is written from the same ones.
# Explaining a movement with a payment the reader cannot find on the page would read as a mistake.
try:
    floor = abs(float(params.get("min_amount") or 0))
except (TypeError, ValueError):
    floor = 0.0
floor_text = "A$" + format(floor, ",.0f")

accounts = change.get("accounts") or []
if accounts and not problem:
    brief = {
        "as_at": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("subtitle") or ""),
        "total_change": str((change.get("summary") or {}).get("totalDifferenceText") or ""),
        "listed_from": floor_text,
        "accounts": [],
    }
    for a in accounts:
        every = a.get("transactions") or []
        big = [t for t in every if abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0)) >= floor]
        small = [t for t in every if abs(float(t.get("amount") or 0)) < floor]
        txns = sorted(big, key=_by_size)
        brief["accounts"].append({
            "name": str(a.get("name") or ""),
            "previous_balance": str(a.get("previousBalanceText") or ""),
            "previous_day": str(a.get("previousDayText") or ""),
            "balance_today": str(a.get("balanceText") or ""),
            "today": str(a.get("todayText") or ""),
            "change": str(a.get("differenceText") or ""),
            "money_in": str(a.get("moneyInText") or ""),
            "money_out": str(a.get("moneyOutText") or ""),
            "transaction_count": len(every),
            "listed_count": len(big),
            "smaller_count": len(small),
            "smaller_total": "A$" + format(abs(sum(float(t.get("amount") or 0) for t in small)), ",.2f"),
            "transactions": [_brief_txn(t) for t in txns[:MAX_TXNS]],
        })

    # A silent fallback here would put the report out with no note at all, so the first failure is kept and
    # a smaller ask is tried before giving up - and if that fails too, the reason is printed on the report.
    written = {}
    try:
        written = api.ai.extract(prompt=WRITE_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(brief)[:MAX_INPUT],
                                 schema_hint=WRITE_SHAPE)
    except Exception as exc:
        reason = str(exc).replace("tool_error: ", "")[:120]
        bare = {"as_at": brief["as_at"], "total_change": brief["total_change"],
                "accounts": [{k: v for k, v in a.items() if k != "transactions"} for a in brief["accounts"]]}
        try:
            written = api.ai.extract(prompt=SHORT_PROMPT, input=json.dumps(bare)[:SHORT_INPUT],
                                     schema_hint=SHORT_SHAPE)
        except Exception:
            written = {}
            notes["note"] = ("AI couldn't write the explanation (" + reason +
                             "). The figures below are straight from Xero and are unaffected.")

    written = written if isinstance(written, dict) else {}
    notes["headline"] = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(written.get("headline") or "")).strip()
    known = {str(a.get("name") or "") for a in accounts}
    for row in written.get("accounts") or []:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        name = str(row.get("name") or "")
        text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(row.get("explanation") or "")).strip()
        # Only keep an explanation that names an account Xero actually returned.
        if name in known and text:
            notes["accounts"].append({"name": name, "explanation": text})
    notes["watch"] = [re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(w)).strip()[:200]
                      for w in (written.get("watch") or []) if str(w).strip()][:4]

summary = problem or notes["note"] or (
    notes["headline"] or "Wrote the explanation for " + str(len(notes["accounts"])) + " account(s).")

= "" logo_uri = "" logo_size = (0, 0) logo_note = "" if logo_file: try: with open(str(api.files.get(file=logo_file)), "rb") as fh: img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(fh.read())) img.load() img.thumbnail(LOGO_PX) buf = io.BytesIO() img.save(buf, format="PNG", optimize=True) kind, ext = "image/png", ".png" if buf.tell() > LOGO_BYTES and img.mode in ("RGB", "L"): buf = io.BytesIO() open(logo_path, "wb") as fh: fh.write(logo_raw) logo_uri = "data:" + kind + ";base64," + base64.b64encode(logo_raw).decode("ascii") except Exception as exc: logo_path = "" logo_uri = "" logo_note = " nodes.summary: Draws the transactions at or above the amount set, account by account, as both a web page and a PDF, puts the web page in Reports, files the PDF in Knowledge as Banking/Reports/<name> Bank Transaction Detail <date>.pdf, and emails it to the people picked.
nodes.title: Write the transaction detail and email it

params.description: Which Xero organisation to report on. Part of the name is enough - "irvine" finds Irvine Jackson Pty Ltd. Leave it blank to use whichever organisation the connection defaults to. An automation does not follow the organisation picker on your dashboard, so if the report names a different organisation than the Bank Balance Change tile, put the tile's organisation here. If what you type matches no connected organisation, or more than one, the run stops and names the ones it found rather than reporting on the wrong books.
params.label: Xero organisation
params.name: xero_org

params.description: Only transactions this size or bigger get a line of their own. Size is what counts, not direction: at A$50,000 a payment of A$60,000 and a receipt of A$60,000 both appear. Everything smaller is counted on one line per account, so the totals still add up. Set it to 0 to list every transaction.
params.label: Smallest transaction to list
params.name: min_amount

params.description: Who in the workspace gets the report.
params.label: Send to person
params.name: email_user

params.description: Any other addresses, for people outside the workspace. Separate several with commas. Leave all three blank and the report is still saved to Reports and Knowledge, but nothing is emailed.
params.label: Other email addresses
params.name: email_to

params.description: Optional. A logo in Knowledge to put at the top of the report, for example Automations/logo.png.
params.label: Logo file
params.name: logo_file
